title: I paid or gave my card details to a scammer: what you can do now
pageTitle: I paid or gave my card details to a scammer: what you can do now | Spamlock
description: Sent money or card details to a scammer? Steps you can take now: call your bank, block the card, change passwords and report the scam.
answer: Call your bank straight away on the number on your card and block the card. Then change any password you shared and report the scam.
stepsTitle: Steps you can take if you paid a scammer

steps.title: Call your bank
steps.text: On the number on your card, not one from a message. You can ask them to stop or reverse the payment.

steps.title: Block the card
steps.text: In your bank app, or ask when you call. A blocked card can’t be used for new payments.

steps.title: Change any password you shared
steps.text: And turn on two-step verification for that account.

steps.title: Report the scam
steps.text: It helps stop others being caught. Outside the US and UK, you can report it to your local police.

steps.title: Watch your statements
steps.text: Check them for the next few months, and tell your bank about any payment you don’t recognise.

app.title: This guide is in the Spamlock app
app.text: Mark each step as done as you go.
